transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Nisha. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Nisha, I'm Rohan Iyer. I've been having some really frustrating issues with my network coverage in my home area and my phone is acting up too.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing these issues, Mr. Iyer. I know how frustrating it is when your service is unreliable.
Customer: Exactly. My phone number is 96707 41655. I just can't get a signal up there and the screen on my device is flickering constantly.
Agent: Let me check the network status for your area. One moment please.
Customer: I've already called three times this month. This is getting ridiculous.
Agent: I see there is some intermittent signal loss in your neighborhood. I will raise a network ticket to have our engineers investigate the local tower.
Customer: A ticket? I just want it fixed now. And what about my flickering screen?
Agent: For the device issue, I can book a device check at our nearest service center for you.
Customer: I have to go to a store? I can't believe this. I'm paying for a service that doesn't work and I'm using a phone that's broken!
Agent: I understand your frustration, but these are the standard procedures for these issues.
Customer: Standard procedures are not enough! This is completely unacceptable. I want to speak to your supervisor immediately.
Agent: I can certainly arrange that for you. Please hold while I transfer you to my manager.
Customer: Just do it now. I'm absolutely fed up with this.
Agent: Before I transfer you, is there anything else I can help you with? I have raised the network ticket and booked the device check. Goodbye for now.
